learner_outcome: A newcomer reads an explicitly sourced growth-baseline and role/organization context snapshot, chooses and completes one bounded real integration action, then leaves a reviewable draft of role-readiness or collaboration-habit evidence without writing any shared fact source.

states.purpose: Orient the learner to Map 02 and disclose isolation, source, and human-gate status.
Read the Exploration Camp baseline and role/organization context before choosing an action.
Choose one bounded real-world action and state when it will happen.
Keep the action card visible while the learner completes the action outside the prototype.
states.primary_action: 我已真实完成，留下证据

states.purpose: Capture minimum, non-sensitive observations that support role readiness or a collaboration habit.
Show exactly what would be handed to the shared Evidence Ledger after authorization and human review.

required_inputs.display_requirement: Show source status and explicitly state that Exploration Camp human validation has not been inferred.
Show role, organization, and collaboration fields only from an authorized source; the prototype must use visibly synthetic placeholders.

first_real_action_options.label: 与角色负责人确认一项当前优先事项及完成标准
与一位协作伙伴确认更新渠道、节奏与需要提前同步的风险
阅读一条近期团队决策记录，并向相关角色复述自己的下一步

machine_acceptance.criterion: Every actionable state exposes exactly one enabled primary action, and clicking alone never claims that the real-world action or shared evidence write succeeded.
The learner must view both input groups, their source status, and the Exploration Camp human-gate warning before choosing an action.
Evidence capture stays unavailable until the learner selects an action, provides a time plan, and explicitly self-attests that the real-world action occurred.
The receipt contains all minimum evidence fields, uses counterpart role rather than a person name, carries a local-draft label, and states that nothing was written to shared sources.
The complete path has no horizontal overflow or hidden primary action at 390, 768, and 1280 CSS pixels.
Keyboard and touch-equivalent controls, reduced motion, validation errors, reload recovery of an unfinished local draft, and restart behavior preserve one clear next action without console errors.
The isolated prototype performs no network request, identity mutation, shared Person/Capability/Evidence/Progress write, invitation creation, or production action.

human_acceptance.protocol: Without facilitator explanation, ask first-time target newcomers what information came from Exploration Camp, what came from role/organization context, and whether either source has been written by this prototype.
human_acceptance.threshold: 3/3 correctly distinguish the two inputs and say the prototype does not write shared facts.

human_acceptance.protocol: Observe first-time target newcomers from arrival through a specific action card without hints.
human_acceptance.threshold: 3/3 independently choose a relevant action, counterpart role, and time plan within 3 minutes; 0 facilitator rescues.

human_acceptance.protocol: Within one working day, verify with the participant that the selected interaction actually occurred; do not treat prototype clicks as proof.
human_acceptance.threshold: 3/3 complete one real interaction with an appropriate work counterpart.

human_acceptance.protocol: A human reviewer checks the participant-authored draft for minimum fields, specificity, privacy, and whether it supports role readiness or a collaboration habit without becoming an employment decision.
human_acceptance.threshold: 3/3 drafts are accepted without requesting private names or confidential details.

human_acceptance.protocol: After receipt, ask for 1-5 ratings on progress clarity and willingness to repeat the collaboration habit.

prohibited_claims: a prototype click proves a real integration action
the evidence draft was saved to the shared Evidence Ledger
role readiness is an employment, promotion, compensation, termination, or performance-rating decision
this map or the full Muchen Journey is released or complete
